title: تشویقی مایع ماهی تن | Voskes
heading: LIQUID TREAT TUNA
description: Spoil your cat with our Liquid Treats with tuna – a creamy and irresistible snack that not only tastes delicious but also provides important health benefits. This variant is made with only natural ingredients and is completely grain-free, allowing your cat to enjoy it responsibly. Thanks to the addition of sunflower oil, rich in omega fatty acids, the Liquid Treats support healthy skin and a shiny coat. This way, your cat not only enjoys a tasty treat but also receives valuable support for its health.
